header: Generated by crosscheck/vectors.py. ct is zlib-compressed hex (Wycheproof CompressedHexBytes).
Valid vectors decrypt to msgLength bytes with SHA-256 msgSha256; invalid ones must fail.

notes.EmptyFinal: The last record holds no data, after full records. RFC 8188 allows it, so another encoder may write it.
notes.Padding: Zero bytes after the delimiter are padding (RFC 8188) and are removed.
notes.CounterRollover: More than 256 records: the index XORed into the nonce reaches its next byte.
notes.HeaderFailure: The header is cut, missing, or names a record size other than 65536 or a key id. It must be refused.
notes.Truncation: The stream is cut: no last record, or a record or tag cut short.
notes.TrailingData: Bytes follow the last record: garbage, or another validly encrypted record.
notes.Delimiter: A record has the delimiter of another position, no delimiter, or a non-zero byte after it.
notes.ChunkReordering: Records are swapped, repeated or dropped. The index in each nonce must make decryption fail.
notes.ModifiedCiphertext: A byte of the header salt, a record or a tag is changed.
notes.WrongKey: A valid stream opened with another secret.
notes.PartialPlaintext: The stream starts with valid records, whose data msgLength and msgSha256 describe. A streaming decrypter may release that prefix before it fails, never more.
